t: 20 high-protein items to buy at Costco, according to a dietitian
s: 3 days ago - It wouldn’t be a Costco roundup without mentioning the Kirkland Seasoned Rotisserie Chicken. At an impressive $4.99 per chicken, it’s easily one of the best deals in the warehouse (just a heads up: it’s usually about a dollar more if you order online). While it’s higher in sodium than buying raw chicken, rotisserie chicken is a major time-saver and a great jumping-off point for plenty of healthy meals — think white chicken chili, enchiladas, salads, soups and wraps.
